preparation: ImageMagick chroma extraction, uniform scaling, and frame packing. Adult nurse only.
prompt:
Redesign the adult female nurse zombie from the supplied reference as a stylish, clearly mature woman around 30 years old. This is a production sprite atlas for a horror action defense game, not a pin-up illustration. Keep her identifiable as a nurse: small white nurse cap with a TEAL stripe (no red cross), untidy dark shoulder-length hair, dangling ID badge. Use an attractive mature face, pale desaturated gray-green skin, cloudy milky eyes, dark eye sockets and a slack threatening expression; she must read as undead rather than a healthy heroine. No gore, open wounds, exposed organs or blood spray.

NEW OUTFIT: fitted opaque ivory-white nurse dress with a tasteful shallow V neckline, dark teal narrow waist belt and teal trim. The dress reaches the lower half of her thighs, with a slightly longer ragged side and an asymmetric torn hem. One short sleeve is torn off at the shoulder, the other sleeve ragged; fabric damage and a few charcoal dirt smudges, not anatomical injury. A small rip at one side of the waist, fully opaque coverage over chest and pelvis in every pose. Dark charcoal opaque tights with a few irregular tears at the knees, practical dark low ankle boots. Adult feminine silhouette and visible waist, natural proportions, no exaggerated breasts/hips, no lingerie, no school uniform. Her dress stays in place during the fall; closed or naturally bent legs, no exposed underwear. Threatening shambling gait, no seductive pose. Semi-realistic hand-painted comic game art, clear dark contours, readable at 150 pixels, restrained three-tone shading, same style as the reference with cleaner silhouettes.

EXACT LAYOUT: 4 columns and 4 evenly spaced rows = 16 complete full-body characters. Every cell has the SAME camera, SAME head size and SAME anatomy scale. Front / slightly three-quarter view approaching the camera. Generous magenta gutter all around each complete figure including hands and feet. NO lines, letters, numbers or labels. Pure uniform solid saturated #FF00FF magenta background everywhere including gaps between limbs, no shadows, no checkerboard, no transparency pattern, no scenery. The character contains no magenta.

Row 1: a complete natural FOUR-FRAME slow WALK CYCLE. Col1 right foot (image left) forward/planted, left arm forward. Col2 passing with right leg supporting and left foot moving through. Col3 left foot (image right) forward/planted, right arm forward. Col4 opposite passing. Genuinely alternate both legs and shoulder rotation, gentle head bob; do not repeat the same leading foot.
Row 2: repeat the exact four walk poses from row 1, at the exact same scale.
Row 3: first FOUR sequential collapse poses, (1) hit reaction still standing at full height, (2) knees buckle, (3) drops onto one knee and reaches for ground, (4) one hand on ground torso leaning sideways.
Row 4: last FOUR sequential collapse poses, (5) hip settles to floor, (6) shoulder lowers to floor, (7) lying still naturally on her side with bent legs, (8) SAME final resting pose with only tiny relaxation. No floating feet, no duplicate limbs. Keep face, outfit details and head diameter identical throughout all 16 frames. Whole resting body fits its cell with clear margins.
